comment: Dr. Kahn is the only professor at this school who actually teaches you how to write. She expects a lot from her students, but if you put in the work and follow her guidelines, her class will be a game changer for your academic future!! You will have to read a lot, but she puts a lot of care into the readings she assigns and makes great selections.

Dr. Kahn is possibly one of the most energetic and passionate professors in the history department at UR. Her lectures are always very engaging and clear. Participation matters heavily in this class so do your best to attend each class.

Take her! I do not like history but taking her Race and Immigration FYS taught me a lot. It is super reading heavy but she balances lectures with group discussions well. 3 papers, quizzes, and reading responses. She genuinely cares about her students and always has something funny to say. Even though I did not like the subject I loved Dr. Kahn!

I had Dr. Kahn for HIST 243 (Nazi Germ.); she made the class enjoyable and worthwhile attending. She sets high expectations for her students but is easily accessible outside of class for further help regarding confusing material. Dr. Kahn always brought a warm energy to class that in-turn motivated and inspired all of her students. She's awesome!

Dr. Kahn is truly one of the most engaging professors I've had at Richmond. She knows her stuff, but goes out of her way to make sure you know it too. HIST249 is one of those classes where you get out what you put into it. She expects quality participation out of her students, but makes the class a very welcoming environment. Loved this course!

Had her for Nazi Germany and FYS. She is an excellent teacher. Her comments on papers are very specific and will improve your writing. She is also super funny and leads discussions well. Her FYS is slightly harder than other FYS' but you'll get more experience. And yea she lifts so you might get a spotter for life. Overall, Highly recommended.

You will not regret taking a class with Dr. Kahn. She is passionate, energetic, and genuinely wants her students to succeed. She knows how to foster engaging discussions and really teach students how to write. If you put in the work during her class you will watch yourself become a much better writer and appreciate her for it!

Dr. Kahn is amazing! She makes the class very interesting and engaging. For papers, her expectations are very clear and office hours are very helpful. She gives a lot of feedback and taking her class will definitely help you improve your writing skills. Also, she helps you to see the connections between history and current events. Take her class!!

Dr. Kahn is one of the best professors I have had at UR. She is passionate about her subject matter, truly cares about each and every single one of her students, and will always go the extra-mile with class. In her course, you will gain awareness: never again will you look at the world in the same way. Clear guidelines to succeed. Work hard!
Wonderful semester. Kahn has clear-cut grading policies and gives specific feedback for her course. Office hours are helpful; and participation is key. You will learn a lot, and have fun doing so.

Taking a class with Dr. Kahn has been such a rewarding experience. She has taught me how to be a better writer and student. The FYS I took Race and Immigration in Europe was very thought-provoking and interesting. We had a lot of interesting discussions. She has clear expectations, gives great feedback, and is easily accessible outside of class.

Such an amazing professor! I had her first semester freshman year and she did a great job of introducing me to college level papers and writing, and definitely helped me improve. Assigns a decent amount of readings, but all are relevant to the class lecture that day, which are all very engaging. Encourages small group discussion and collaboration.

Incredible prof!! She really is so passionate about her work and wants to help her students succeed. As long as you do the readings and participate you should get a good grade. She is very funny and I looked forward to coming to class. Hope to take her again even though I am not a history major. Also really helped improve my writing.
Do it. Just do it. Dr. Kahn is the best and really knows her stuff. You need her as your professor or your college life wont be complete
10/10 would retake. Super clear grading rubrics and wants all students to do great in class.

Dr. Kahn is AMAZING. She will make you work hard, but will be there every step of the way. She handled the switch to online class flawlessly and is ready to handle anything. She works really hard to make every class fun and creative. She made me love history and think about things in ways I never had before. Do yourself a favor and take her class.

Dr. Kahn is the best professor I have had at UR. She is so funny and energetic and I feel like I really learned from her. She does her best to be creative and helps you bring out your passions. She made my gen ed totally worth it and I learned so much and did not waste my time. She is really willing to help you learn to participate and write better

Dr. Kahn will change your life and inspire you. Dr. Kahn includes so many different perspectives that often get overlooked in history. She brings you into the history and the debates and issues historians are having today and wants to hear your voice. She wants you to see how history has implications and is relevant on campus and in the real world.

Absolutely love Dr. Kahn. She is relatable, funny, very intelligent, relaxed, and easy to understand. Her Nazi Germany class is super interesting and not hard at all. She is also super open in office hours, easy to talk to, and gives great feedback. I would highly recommend her and any of her classes.
Best professor ever. Will give you feedback and meet with you if you put the effort into it. Intelligent and funny. Take her.
Amazing and wonderful teacher. She is very passionate about educating people about the proper history of World War II.

Best professor I've had so far! Makes class extremely interesting even if the class isn't in your field of study. Values her student's contributions and is always available to help with papers either in person or by email. Has specific and strict guidelines and is a hard grader but wants the best for her students. Definitely take a class with her!!

Dr. Kahn is probably the most hardworking and inspiring professors at UR. She is brilliant and has so much passion for her work and students. She sets high standards and is clear about what she expects. However, she will work with you to help you reach those standards and figure out how to improve. She and the courses she teaches change your life.

Dr. Kahn is truly awesome. She is extremely smart and knowledgeable about the topics she is teaching on, and she keeps her classes enjoyable through a good mixture of humor and very interesting readings. I would definitely take classes from her again, and would recommend her to all my friends :)
You can't ask for a better professor, Dr Kahn is just amazing. Take her class without second thought! You will not regret it.

Dr. Kahn is truly amazing and Richmond does not deserve her. She is brilliant and taking a class with her will probably change your life. She makes class interesting and engaging. She will push you to grow as a scholar, but is willing to put in the work to help you reach your full potential. She gives you tools to succeed in her class and in life.

I love Dr Kahn she is the best professor at U of R! She is extremely engaging and makes every topic interesting. She also really cares about her students and makes the effort to get to know them. You will not regret taking her!

Dr. Kahn is so so amazing! She really cares about students and wants to see them succeed. Meeting her outside of class is super helpful and rewarding. I would definitely recommend taking her class for the history gen-ed or honestly for anything!!

Dr. Kahn was my favorite professor at UR. She is extremely thoughtful and her advice truly made me a better student and writer. Its not hard to do well as long as you do what she asks of you. The class was intimidating at first since I dont particularly like history, but Im very glad I took it.

Class with DrKahn turned out to be much better than I had expected. She is an amazing teacher. She tells us clearly what she expects from us. Her lectures are inspirational, esp for a history class, and she is always flexible in her materials. She knows how to make all students engaged by thinking of different ways for class discussion. must take

Dr. Kahn exceeds expectations as a college professor. She is always prepared for class and makes it fun. She is thorough when providing feedback. She's available for office hours very often. Dr. Kahn puts in a lot of effort to make sure that students walk away more knowledgable than when they first arrived in her class. Def my fav prof! 10/10 :)

Professor Kahn is the best Professor I have ever had. She gave a few lectures. Instead, we did lots of discussions. Readings she assigned were generally easy and interesting. We had two mandatory paper and one optional paper throughout the semester. She is the reason why I'm pursuing a history minor now. Take her class!
